summary: Large right-sided pleural effusion with meniscus seen on prior has resolved on current, with aerated lung now visible in that region.

findings.rationale: Prior shows a large curvilinear meniscus-shaped opacity filling the right lower hemithorax, obscuring the costophrenic angle. Current shows this region now clear with visible lung markings down to the diaphragm. Caveat: differing support-device overlay and patient rotation.
